signs.aries: You take up a belief with conviction and drop it just as decisively, and you travel on impulse rather than by itinerary.
signs.taurus: You arrive at your convictions slowly and then hold them for life, and you travel to places you can return to again and again.
signs.gemini: You collect ideas and philosophies without settling on one, study widely and shallowly, and travel often and lightly.
signs.cancer: Your beliefs come from your upbringing whether you kept them or reacted against them, and you travel best with people you love.
signs.leo: You believe wholeheartedly and say so, teach naturally, and travel in a way that makes a story worth telling afterwards.
signs.virgo: You are sceptical of grand claims and want the evidence, study a subject properly rather than broadly, and plan travel in detail.
signs.libra: You weigh competing philosophies fairly and struggle to commit to one, and you are drawn to other cultures for their beauty.
signs.scorpio: You cannot leave a belief unexamined, are drawn to what a religion or ideology hides, and travel to be changed by it.
signs.sagittarius: This is your home ground: study, travel and meaning are where you expand, and the horizon is always the interesting part.
signs.capricorn: You want a philosophy that will bear weight, are suspicious of easy answers, and study or travel with a purpose in mind.
signs.aquarius: You built your worldview yourself out of dissatisfaction with the one handed to you, and it is more radical than you let on.
signs.pisces: Your faith is felt rather than reasoned, you are drawn to the mystical rather than the doctrinal, and travel has a dreamlike quality for you.
